answer: Seeded slot lottery. Each epoch, a verifiable random function over the epoch seed and agent ID assigns agents to a limited attention plume of task slots. Only assigned agents may act that round; a swarm of fake IDs gains nothing because slot occupancy is uncorrelated with ID count and the seed is revealed only after assignments commit. An attacker must run many real identities across epochs to land slots, paying compute and elapsed time per identity, with no cheap haven for idle fakes and no way to precompute a favorable hollow of assignments.
